owner: PCB integration; discipline owners in group entries
scope: All four active electric-build PCBs, not historical snapshots or the future acoustic design

groups.evidence_needed: All mains branch ratings and simulations at 198/220/235.4 V, 50 Hz; 242 V extra stress separately
groups.acceptance_basis: Normal supply bounds and chosen transformer/supply operating limits
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Normal supply bounds and chosen transformer/supply operating limits
groups.assessment: Mains branch and selected transformer qualification remains open; PCB DRC does not test 50 Hz or high-line operation.

groups.evidence_needed: Cord/inlet/switch/bond drawings, exact ratings, assembly review and physical protective checks
groups.acceptance_basis: Applicable equipment requirements and selected power-entry parts
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Applicable equipment requirements and selected power-entry parts
groups.assessment: Dedicated PE is required in the architecture; final inlet, fuse, switch, bond and assembled cable routing are not qualified.

groups.evidence_needed: Derived clearance/creepage matrix, configured CAD rules and assembled off-board review
groups.acceptance_basis: Working/transient voltages, insulation class, environment, material and applicable requirements
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Working/transient voltages, insulation class, environment, material and applicable requirements
groups.assessment: Main and Power have explicit 5.5 mm functional HV copper rules, but no complete derived working/transient voltage and creepage matrix; assembly leads and metal remain unchecked.

groups.evidence_needed: Topology, winding RMS current, startup/no-load/load waveforms, capacitor/diode/resistor stress and discharge evidence
groups.acceptance_basis: Exact parts and modeled/physical worst-case conditions
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Exact parts and modeled/physical worst-case conditions
groups.assessment: Power has 39 unconnected items; exact reservoirs/magnetics remain unselected. R40 startup pulse qualification remains open. No fresh power simulation was run by this audit.

groups.area: Fuse inrush surge and filter coordination
groups.evidence_needed: Input/inrush budget, fuse characteristic, MOV coordination and safety-cap/leakage assessment where fitted
groups.acceptance_basis: Actual protective-device curves, ratings and applicable requirements
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Actual protective-device curves, ratings and applicable requirements
groups.assessment: Fuse curves, fault clearing, transformer inrush and coordinated surge/filter ratings have not been closed.

groups.evidence_needed: Original plus reverb/lamp load budget, socket voltages, reference and heater-cathode startup stresses
groups.acceptance_basis: Chosen tube datasheets and winding capability over declared input cases
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Chosen tube datasheets and winding capability over declared input cases
groups.assessment: Heaters and sockets are off board. Six original tubes remain required. Pair routing, socket voltage and heater-cathode limits require the final harness and selected tubes.

groups.area: Bias plate screen and grid stress
groups.evidence_needed: Operating-point/drive sweeps, grid DC returns, bias adjustment/wiper-loss and sequencing assessment
groups.acceptance_basis: Exact tube ratings, circuit resistances and intended operating region
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Exact tube ratings, circuit resistances and intended operating region
groups.assessment: Pad/net mapping is consistent with the circuit contract; that does not qualify exact tubes, bias wiper-loss, startup, grid/screen stress or socket-end stopper placement.

groups.evidence_needed: Reflected load, bass/drive, phasing, reactive loads and protected unloaded-condition assessment
groups.acceptance_basis: Selected transformer/tubes/speaker and declared output target
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Selected transformer/tubes/speaker and declared output target
groups.assessment: Selected output transformer/load and reactive-load qualification remain open. Earlier approximately 412 kHz ringing remains unresolved; no new simulation result is claimed.

groups.area: Audio gain loading clipping and recovery
groups.evidence_needed: Stage gain/headroom/loading/frequency budget, intended clipping and overload-recovery tests
groups.acceptance_basis: Agreed input/load/controls, voicing, bandwidth and distortion limits
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Agreed input/load/controls, voicing, bandwidth and distortion limits
groups.assessment: Earlier 118-case input fixture is scoped evidence for keeping the original input, not complete hot-humbucker or selected-component amplifier qualification.

groups.evidence_needed: Tank/driver/transformer match, unplug behavior, wet/dry loading and physical hum/rattle/feedback tests
groups.acceptance_basis: Selected tank and parts, intended drive/mix range and measured packaging behavior
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Selected tank and parts, intended drive/mix range and measured packaging behavior
groups.assessment: 76/235 ohm measured DC winding resistances are recorded; supplier 600/2250 ohm AC ratings lack test conditions and safe drive limit. Reverb DRC passes connectivity, not tank temperature or installed hum.

groups.area: Control pedal relay and switching states
groups.evidence_needed: State table, debounce/reset, plug/unplug/TRS shorts, isolation, coil/contact stress and audio-pop evidence
groups.acceptance_basis: Exact logic/relay/jack ratings and agreed transition limits
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Exact logic/relay/jack ratings and agreed transition limits
groups.assessment: F03: suppression diodes D331/D341 are on Control, while K1/K2 are on Main and K3 on Reverb. Expression-pedal circuit/PCB is absent; supervisor/relay sequencing remains open.

groups.evidence_needed: Board and off-board return/shield/chassis diagram, isolation exceptions, reservoir/heater/control segregation
groups.acceptance_basis: Actual topology and traced current paths; retain protective earth
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Actual topology and traced current paths; retain protective earth
groups.assessment: All four boards have zero copper zones. Routed GND is not a verified whole-amp return plan. Rectifier, coil, heater, speaker, RCA and chassis paths must be traced together.

groups.evidence_needed: Socket/grid-stopper geometry, aggressor/return review, high-impedance keepouts and measured stability/hum
groups.acceptance_basis: Actual stage impedance, edge rates, magnetics and component/layout requirements
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Actual stage impedance, edge rates, magnetics and component/layout requirements
groups.assessment: F02: Control local bypass placement fails proximity intent; Reverb bypass and feedback paths need re-placement and loop review. Off-board grid, transformer and cable coupling remain unverified.

groups.area: Symbol footprint pin view and fit
groups.evidence_needed: Symbol-pad-pin mapping, socket viewing direction, exact body/lead/hole dimensions and received-part inspection
groups.acceptance_basis: Selected-part drawings and physical sample dimensions
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Selected-part drawings and physical sample dimensions
groups.assessment: All 184 on-board circuit references match contract pads/nets; 68 wire ports match the board plan; 46 circuit references are accounted as off board. 52 on-board circuit refs have no selected MPN; actual lead/body/socket verification remains incomplete.

groups.area: Cabinet control heat vibration and service
groups.source_rule_refs: TUBE-054; CN-030; PWR-012; LAY-001..002; LAY-054..055; PROJECT-top-front-controls
groups.evidence_needed: Real shell/chassis/speaker/tank dimensions, top/front control access, full-size fit and in-box thermal/vibration results
groups.acceptance_basis: Canonical prototype requirements, actual envelopes and part thermal limits
groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Canonical prototype requirements, actual envelopes and part thermal limits
groups.assessment: Four PCB areas total 109900 square mm versus 74720 for the reported 467 by 160 mm plane. No qualified stacked assembly. Fixed-structure mounts, rear-cover independence, drill approach, extraction, tube heat and speaker/tank clearances remain open.

groups.evidence_needed: Vendor capability, electrical rule derivation, zone refill, parity/ERC/DRC review and CAM/plated/nonplated drill inspection

groups.check_method: Native inventory/strict DRC/copper geometry/render review plus existing evidence review; see report for bounds.
groups.acceptance_limit: Actual chosen vendor stack/capability plus stricter derived electrical constraints
groups.assessment: F01/F04/F05/F06: 243 unconnected items, 68 missing wire-pad courtyards exposed by strict DRC, three remaining simple bend candidates, no qualified current-specific widths or fabrication stackup. Native paired schematic parity unavailable.

groups.acceptance_limit: Agreed numerical methods and applicable electrical requirements

APCB-009: No intentional balanced audio input in this electric revision; reopen if one is added.
AUD-038: No balanced audio interface specified in current electric build; this does not exempt unbalanced shield/return design.
APCB-015: Current speaker output is transformer-coupled, not a bridge-tied semiconductor output.
TRACE-020: No intentional balanced audio pair in current electric build.
TRACE-051: No balanced cable interface currently specified; general chassis/shield and PE requirements remain applicable.
TRACE-046: No class-D output stage in current tube amplifier.
TRACE-042: No switching regulator in these four active boards; revisit if auxiliary supply topology changes.
TRACE-043: No switching regulator in these four active boards; relay switching still requires local suppression.
LAY-034: These four boards use linear regulation, not a switching converter; rectifier pulse loops remain applicable.
